blurb: The Battleground at Deer Park is an 18-hole golf course featuring a championship layout with varied tee lengths suitable for both seasoned and novice players. The course includes rolling fairways, manicured greens, strategically-placed water hazards, and a historic Pratt Truss Bridge that golfers cross twice during their round. The venue also hosts weddings, social events, and tournaments, and includes The Republic Grill dining room with views of the course.
